content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHM Meghalaya State DRBT Coordinator Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM Meghalaya to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Meghalaya State DRBT Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NHM Meghalaya State DRBT Coordinator position is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the State DRBT Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a Medical Institution recognized by the Medical Council of India to be eligible for the State DRBT Coordinator position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the State DRBT Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the State DRBT Coordinator post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the NHM Meghalaya recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the State DRBT Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the State DRBT Coordinator post involves a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NHM Meghalaya State DRBT Coordinator job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official NHM Meghalaya website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the NHM Meghalaya State DRBT Coordinator recruitment is DHS/MCH&FW/NHM/Appt-SPMU/113/2022/(XXXVI).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity with the National Health Mission Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this post?
faq.answer: The job is located in Shillong, Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Meghalaya apply?
faq.answer: The official notification should be checked for specific domicile requirements. Generally, state-level recruitments might have preferences or requirements for local residents.
